title.original: olmOCR: Unlocking Trillions of Tokens in PDFs with Vision Language Models
title.zh: olmOCR：借助视觉语言模型释放 PDF 中的万亿级 token
title.en: olmOCR: Unlocking Trillions of Tokens in PDFs with Vision Language Models

inclusion_reason.zh: olmOCR 提供可部署的开源 PDF 解析模型、批处理运行时和基准工具链，可作为大规模训练语料抽取基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: olmOCR provides a deployable open PDF model, batch runtime, and benchmark stack that can serve as infrastructure for extracting training corpora at scale.

abstract.zh: olmOCR 是面向大规模 PDF 语料构建的开源视觉 OCR 工具链，可把复杂页面转换为自然阅读顺序的线性文本，同时尽量保留章节、表格、列表和公式结构。
abstract.en: olmOCR is an open-source visual OCR stack for large PDF collections that produces linearized text in natural reading order while retaining structures such as sections, tables, lists, and equations.

problem.zh: PDF 的版式、扫描质量和视觉结构高度多样，传统解析器质量不足，而调用闭源视觉模型成本高且可能违反数据出域约束。
problem.en: PDFs vary widely in layout and scan quality; traditional parsers lose structure, while proprietary vision models are costly and may be unusable when documents cannot leave a controlled environment.

approach.zh: 作者微调一个 7B 视觉语言模型处理多样页面，并配套训练数据、批处理推理管线及涵盖困难版式的 olmOCR-Bench 进行系统比较。
approach.en: The authors fine-tune a 7B vision-language model on diverse pages and pair it with a batch inference pipeline, released training assets, and olmOCR-Bench for difficult document layouts.

system_design.zh: 页面经过渲染与批量调度后送入视觉语言模型，输出按阅读顺序重排并保留结构标记；执行层可接入 vLLM 或 SGLang 后端以适配不同硬件。
system_design.en: Rendered pages are batch-scheduled to the vision-language model, whose output is reordered into readable structured text; the execution layer supports vLLM and SGLang backends across hardware setups.

key_results.zh: 在作者构建的困难 PDF 基准上，olmOCR 的提取质量优于所比较的传统工具和多种强视觉模型，同时显著降低大规模处理成本。
key_results.en: On the authors' challenging PDF benchmark, olmOCR surpasses the compared traditional tools and strong vision models while making large-batch processing materially cheaper.

limitations.zh: 训练数据和基准仍可能遗漏低资源语言、特殊符号及罕见版式；视觉模型会产生难以察觉的转写错误，批处理成本也依赖具体硬件与后端。
limitations.en: The training mix and benchmark may miss low-resource languages, specialized notation, and rare layouts; silent transcription errors remain possible, and throughput costs depend on hardware and backend choice.

metrics.name: PDF processing cost per million pages

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
